# bugs #3004: gbz80 -ba: a second .area _DATA line follows the selected data area

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/3004/
- Category: [Already fixed in trunk](../../fixed-upstream.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17176
- Recommended action: Close as fixed in r11774.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

On r17176 the declaration in the ticket is preceded by one `.area` line when another data segment
is selected. The compiler that was tested has no sm83 port, so `-ba1` could not be used. `-ba1`
sets `options.data_seg` to `DATA_1` in `src/z80/main.c`, and `--dataseg DATA_1` sets the same
variable. With `-mz80 --dataseg DATA_1` the assembly has `.area _DATA_1` before `_test` and no
`.area _DATA`. With `-mmcs51 --dataseg DATA_1` it has one `.area DATA_1  (DATA)` line.

## Fixed by

[r11774](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/code/11774/), which the assignee of the ticket committed
two days after the assignment. Before it, `emitRegularMap` in `src/SDCCglue.c` wrote an `!areadata`
line with the name of the map and then an `!area` line with `options.data_seg`. Since r11774 the
function writes one `!areadata` line. The line has `options.data_seg` when that differs from the
default name, and the name of the map otherwise.
